svg.title: Congestion pricing analysis method
svg.desc: Camera map with the Congestion Relief Zone, a 352 by 240 camera frame, the per-camera aggregation steps, and the peak observed cars per frame before and after pricing for every camera.
svg.text: YOLO-LR, trained on COCO at 352 × 352, counts
cars, buses, trucks, motorcycles, and bicycles
in every frame. 770 of the 910 cameras stream
weekday or weekend, before or after
2 cameras with peaks below 0.1 not shown
